title: 2013 Marshmallow Twist: Broken Promises Cut Patience by 75%
topic: Why Broken Promises — Not Weak Willpower — Crash the Marshmallow Test
act5_climax_episode: In 2013 at the University of Rochester, Celeste Kidd broke vs kept an art-supply promise before the 15-minute Marshmallow Test — jumping average wait time fourfold from 3 minutes to 12 minutes.
